release_notes:
Ready Messages log: fix the newest Ready being clipped after sending or receiving a message (follow-up to 1.0.76).

1.0.76 fixed the same symptom on startup, but the same bug existed on every live insert. Root cause: _append_incoming_ready_log and _append_ready_log both called self.log.see('end') INSIDE the try/finally that wrote the new entry -- BEFORE the subsequent _refresh_separators() call. _refresh_separators rebuilds every divider between entries, which adds one new separator line above the newest entry. That shift moved the newest entry one display-line further down than where see('end') had just anchored the viewport, so the most recent Ready landed just off the bottom of the visible area. Sending an outgoing Ready or receiving a new one therefore clipped exactly the line the user most needed to see.

Fix: move the see('end') call to AFTER _refresh_separators() and _trim_log_to_max_entries() in both functions. By then the layout is final and the bottom anchors correctly. No other log behavior changes; the trim cap, separator placement, emphasis tiers, and persistence path are unchanged.
